product.title: Paris Montmartre Food & Wine Tour with Eating Europe

description.text: In Paris, walk the hill of Montmartre with a local food guide, tasting baguette, macarons, cheese, charcuterie, and choux à la crème while sipping French wine and apple cider. The small-group route starts at Le Pain Quotidien on Rue Lepic and finishes at Basilique du Sacré-Cœur, with scenic viewpoints over Paris as you eat and drink like a neighborhood regular. Stops include Le Pain Quotidien, Rue Lepic, Montmartre, Basilique du Sacré-Cœur de Montmartre. Local commentary and route logistics are handled so you can focus on Paris landmarks, river views, and neighborhood walking or cycling highlights. Ideal for visitors basing in Paris who want a guided city experience without coordinating Metro routes, attraction tickets, or landmark timing on their own. Routes stay oriented to Le Pain Quotidien, Rue Lepic, Montmartre, Basilique du Sacré-Cœur de Montmartre that define this Paris sightseeing experience, with a guide handling Metro connections, ticket windows, and neighborhood pacing so the day stays focused on the city rather than logistics.
